groups.name: Prestige dramas that never won a single Emmy for Outstanding Drama Series
groups.explanation: Deadwood, The Wire, Treme, and Six Feet Under are all widely considered landmark prestige dramas but none of them ever won the Emmy for Outstanding Drama Series — a notorious awards blind spot. (Six Feet Under won Outstanding Drama Series in 2002, so this needs a replacement — see correction: Six Feet Under never won Outstanding Drama Series; it won other categories. Confirmed: Outstanding Drama Series winners do not include Six Feet Under, The Wire, Deadwood, or Treme. All four belong here.)

groups.name: TV lead characters whose backstory includes a stolen or fabricated identity
groups.explanation: Don Draper (Mad Men) stole a dead soldier's identity and lived as Dick Whitman in secret; Tony Soprano (The Sopranos) presents himself as a legitimate waste management consultant while running the mob; Coach Taylor (Friday Night Lights) is a deliberate misdirect — he does NOT have a fabricated identity, so he is removed. CORRECTION: replacing Coach Taylor and restructuring. Don Draper stole Dick Whitman's identity; Jack Bauer (24) routinely operates under false cover identities; Walter White fabricates his Heisenberg persona; Tony Soprano projects a false civilian identity. These four TV leads all constructed false public identities central to their characters.

groups.name: Shows whose final season premiered on a different network or platform than its debut season
groups.explanation: Friday Night Lights debuted on NBC but its final seasons aired on DirecTV's The 101 Network before airing on NBC; Arrested Development debuted on Fox and its final season aired on Netflix; Community debuted on NBC and its final season (Season 6) aired on Yahoo Screen; Succession began and ended on HBO — this is a trap tile that does not fit and must be replaced. CORRECTION: Succession stayed on HBO throughout, so it is removed. Replacing with a show that genuinely moved: Scrubs debuted on NBC and its final season aired on ABC. Revised group: Friday Night Lights, Arrested Development, Community, Scrubs.
